snippet.title: Armored Core: Project Phantasma Playthrough (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Armored Core Series: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPO56tlewLYRryyxnGYWHOXf2D1PmFxbC
Released several months after the original Armored Core, Project Phantasma can be thought of as a level pack. Like with Armored Core, there are branching paths for the missions but to a much lesser degree. It has no effect on the final mission and ending.
Importing your save from Armored Core is possible and I do so for this playthrough.

Vulkan rendering is being used here along with PGXP and PGXP's perspective correct texturing option.
Nothing particularly notable about the edit here. There are ~16 edits. There are no in-mission edits and I show all of my part purchases.

00:00 Intro
00:42 Search and Destroy
02:42 Infiltrate Amber Base
09:27 Rescue The Allies
12:56 Raid The Laboratory
21:23 The Underground Maze 
24:38 Disrupt Shipping Lanes
28:01 Capture The VIP
32:52 Protect The VIP
36:45 Destroy The Detachment
39:52 Destroy Main Facility
48:21 Confrontation
52:52 Destroy Secret Base
57:51 Search The Facility
1:03:47 The Final Battle
1:06:14 Ending
1:07:14 Credits
